contradicted.claim: OVD-598 says requirement requested_by_date and applicable_vendors can change between validation and lane/permit creation without being detected, because they are not in the scope fingerprint.
contradicted.actual: Partly wrong. Every UPDATE to the requirement row bumps updated_at through a trigger, and updated_at is in the fingerprinted snapshot as requirements.capturedAt. So any requirement edit committed before the lane is built aborts admission with xometry_beta_scope_changed or xometry_beta_created_lane_mismatch. applicable_vendors also filters the candidates, so removing xometry produces no lane and xometry_beta_new_lane_required. Two gaps are real: (1) jobs.requested_service_kinds/primary_service_kind and job_files file_kind/job_id/organization_id are validated but not fingerprinted. Internal users can change them directly through the RLS policies jobs_update_internal and job_files_update_internal, and the worker can too. (2) No row locks are taken, so an edit committed during issuance does not wait. That leaves a stale permit, lane and task; the worker preflight later refuses it because the fingerprints no longer match.
contradicted.evidence: 20260926225000_confirm_sourcing_intent.sql:410 ('capturedAt', requirement.updated_at) and :476 (vendor = any(requirement.applicable_vendors)). 20260303101500_curated_cnc_quote_platform.sql:344-347 (BEFORE UPDATE trigger touch_updated_at). quote_scope_fingerprint hashes the whole snapshot text (20260812041000:281-289). Worker recheck: 20260817054500:369. Client edits through api_update_client_part_request also upsert the requirement row, which bumps updated_at.

This is the same order as #573:404-432. (2) `create or replace` public.api_request_xometry_beta_dispatch, byte-identical to the #564 version except for one call to the new helper right after the xometry-beta-approval advisory lock and before resolve_xometry_beta_dispatch_scope_with_access. R3, editor holds an uncommitted `update jobs set requested_service_kinds = <a valid set besides manufacturing_quote only>`; the request blocks, then fails with xometry_beta_manufacturing_quote_only.
